facts.text: Grand Hotel Royal is in the heart of Sorrento, perched over the sea and overlooking the Gulf of Naples and Mount Vesuvius.
facts.excerpt: in the heart of Sorrento, perched over the sea in a privileged location overlooking the Gulf of Naples and Mount Vesuvius

facts.text: Grand Hotel Royal is a member of Alberghi Storici d'Italia (Historic Hotels of Italy).
facts.excerpt: Grand Hotel Royal, the member of Alberghi Storici d’Italia (Historic Hotels of Italy)

facts.text: The hotel was built in 1898 and drew aristocrats from all over Europe to grand gala evenings on its terrace high above the sea.
facts.excerpt: Built in 1898, this was the hotel for the aristocracy who flocked from all over Europe to enjoy the grand gala evenings on the terrace high above the sea

facts.text: The interiors keep original pieces of antique inlaid wood furniture from Sorrento.
facts.excerpt: The interiors continue to maintain the elegance of the past with original pieces of antique inlay wood furniture from Sorrento.

facts.text: The entrance hall features marble staircases and Murano crystal chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: refined marble staircases, Murano crystal chandeliers and classy furnishings

facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by a large park with exotic plants, camellias, and orange and lemon trees.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by a large park boasting exotic plants, amazing camellias, orange and lemon trees

facts.text: A landscaped swimming pool sits on the edge of the tuff cliff, with a Jacuzzi and a large sundeck.
facts.excerpt: A landscaped swimming pool on the edge of the tuff cliff, with a Jacuzzi and a large fully equipped sundeck

facts.text: The hotel has a Blue Flag private beach on a platform over the sea, reached directly from the hotel by a private lift.
facts.excerpt: An exclusive Blue Flag private beach set on a platform overlooking the sea, accessible directly from the hotel via a private lift.

facts.text: The beach can also be reached by a scenic path through tunnels in the tuff stone, interspersed with Mediterranean gardens.
facts.excerpt: by following a scenic path that winds through tunnels set within the characteristic tuff stone, interspersed with Mediterranean gardens

facts.text: The private beach is open from 15 May to 15 October.
facts.excerpt: Open from 15 May to 15 October.

facts.text: The wellness center La Villetta offers massages by expert therapists.
facts.excerpt: The new and luxurious wellness center "La Villetta" of Grand Hotel Royal, boasts wonderful massage parlours endowed with the latest equipments, where our expert therapists will host you

facts.text: The fitness room has Technogym equipment.
facts.excerpt: A comfortable gym with Technogym® technologically advanced equipment with everything for a perfect workout.

facts.text: The suites have been renewed and have a 4K Bang & Olufsen flat-screen TV.
facts.excerpt: Discover the new enchanting Suites, all renewed with fine details and provided with a 4K "Bang & Olufsen" wide flat-screen TV.

facts.text: Most rooms have a view over the Bay of Naples or the gardens.
facts.excerpt: Most of the rooms enjoy a breathtaking view over the Bay of Naples or the magnificent gardens.

facts.text: Rooms have Vietri majolica floors hand-painted by artisan masters.
facts.excerpt: Vietri majolica floors hand-painted by artisan masters

facts.text: Le Caprice Lounge Bar serves afternoon tea and the regional liqueur Limoncello.
facts.excerpt: It is the perfect location to taste an afternoon tea or a glass of the traditional regional liqueur Limoncello, ideal after dinner.

facts.text: The a la carte restaurant La Terrasse Royal has a view over the Gulf.
facts.excerpt: Equally unmissable is the à la cart restaurant “La Terrasse Royal”, with its breathtaking view over the Gulf and its excellent cuisine.

facts.text: The Restaurant & Bar Bellevue near the pool serves grilled specialties, salads and Neapolitan pizzas under lemon, orange and palm trees.
facts.excerpt: Lunchtime means grilled specialties, fresh salads or great Neapolitan pizzas, that guests will enjoy under the shade of lemon, orange and palm trees.

facts.text: The hotel has an internal parking lot.
facts.excerpt: An internal parking lot

facts.text: Free high-speed Wi-Fi covers the entire property.
facts.excerpt: High-speed free Wi-Fi access throughout the entire property

facts.text: The hotel is certified to ISO 9001, ISO 13009 and ISO 14001, covering quality management, beach operation and environmental management.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hotel Royal is certified according to UNI EN ISO 9001, ISO 13009 and ISO 14001 standards, covering quality management, beach operation and environmental management respectively.

facts.text: Between the two wars, the hotel hosted Italian Prime Minister Francesco Saverio Nitti.
facts.excerpt: Between the two wars, the hotel welcomed the Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Italy, Francesco Saverio Nitti.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself classy and stylish.
facts.excerpt: Classy and stylish five-star estate in the heart of Sorrento
